key_insight: The paper proposes a static PV array reconfiguration method that uses the actual partial-shading pattern to maximize power output without needing dynamic switching.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more practical and lower-complexity way to improve solar plant efficiency under predictable shading from buildings, trees, and other fixed obstructions.
method: Model the real shading pattern on the PV array instead of assuming a generic shaded region.
Reconfigure modules statically to improve electrical matching and reduce mismatch losses.
Validate the approach on both square-array simulation and a small-scale non-square laboratory prototype.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the proposed method consistently achieved optimal power output in both software simulation and practical experiments compared with existing techniques.
watch_item: Because the approach is static, its effectiveness may drop if shading patterns change significantly after installation.
paper_title: An Integer Linear Programming Approach for Maximum Power Extraction from Solar PV Plants under Partial Shading
